definition: to serve someone food from a shared dish
description: At a dinner in a white-walled courtyard at dusk, under strings of lights, pink bougainvillea and lemon trees in pots, a laughing young woman in a linen apron leans over a long wooden table and lifts a big spoonful of yellow seafood rice with prawns from a wide pan onto a man's plate. He raises his hands happily, she serves more and then stands back laughing. Friends around the table laugh, and there are plates of rice, a salad bowl, a water jug, lemon wedges and candles in jars.

taps.phrase: to scoop rice onto a plate

taps.target: the man in the striped shirt
